1.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

2.web: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am Yahweh.
2.asv: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, that they separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they hallow unto me, and that they profane not my holy name: I am Jehovah.

3.web: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your seed throughout your generations approaches the holy things, which the children of Israel make holy to Yahweh, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am Yahweh.
3.asv: Say unto them, Whosoever he be of all your seed throughout your generations, that approacheth unto the holy things, which the children of Israel hallow unto Jehovah, having his uncleanness upon him, that soul shall be cut off from before me: I am Jehovah.

4.web: “‘Whoever of the seed of Aaron is a leper or has an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goes from him;
4.asv: What man soever of the seed of Aaron is a leper, or hath an issue; he shall not eat of the holy things, until he be clean. And whoso toucheth anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man whose seed goeth from him;

5.web: or whoever touches any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever uncleanness he has;
5.asv: or whosoever toucheth any creeping thing, whereby he may be made unclean, or a man of whom he may take uncleanness, whatsoever uncleanness he hath;

6.web: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his body in water.
6.asv: the soul that toucheth any such shall be unclean until the even, and shall not eat of the holy things, unless he bathe his flesh in water.

7.web: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.
7.asv: And when the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

8.web: That which dies of itself, or is torn by animals, he shall not eat, defiling himself by it. I am Yahweh.
8.asv: That which dieth of itself, or is torn of beasts, he shall not eat, to defile himself therewith: I am Jehovah.

9.web: “‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it. I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.
9.asv: They shall therefore keep my charge, lest they bear sin for it, and die therein, if they profane it: I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

10.web: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.
10.asv: There shall no stranger eat of the holy thing: a sojourner of the priest’s, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

11.web: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.
11.asv: But if a priest buy any soul, the purchase of his money, he shall eat of it; and such as are born in his house, they shall eat of his bread.

12.web: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.
12.asv: And if a priest’s daughter be married unto a stranger, she shall not eat of the heave-offering of the holy things.

13.web: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house, as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread: but no stranger shall eat any of it.
13.asv: But if a priest’s daughter be a widow, or divorced, and have no child, and be returned unto her father’s house, as in her youth, she shall eat of her father’s bread: but there shall no stranger eat thereof.

14.web: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.
14.asv: And if a man eat of the holy thing unwittingly, then he shall put the fifth part thereof unto it, and shall give unto the priest the holy thing.

15.web: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to Yahweh,
15.asv: And they shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer unto Jehovah,

16.web: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt, when they eat their holy things; for I am Yahweh who sanctifies them.’”
16.asv: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that bringeth guilt, when they eat their holy things: for I am Jehovah who sanctifieth them.

17.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

18.web: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill offerings, which they offer to Yahweh for a burnt offering;
18.asv: Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them, Whosoever he be of the house of Israel, or of the sojourners in Israel, that offereth his oblation, whether it be any of their vows, or any of their freewill-offerings, which they offer unto Jehovah for a burnt-offering;

19.web: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.
19.asv: that ye may be accepted, ye shall offer a male without blemish, of the bullocks, of the sheep, or of the goats.

20.web: But whatever has a defect, that you shall not offer; for it shall not be acceptable for you.
20.asv: But whatsoever hath a blemish, that shall ye not offer: for it shall not be acceptable for you.

21.web: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to Yahweh to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.
21.asv: And whosoever offereth a sacrifice of peace-offerings unto Jehovah to accomplish a vow, or for a freewill-offering, of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted; there shall be no blemish therein.

22.web: Blind, injured, maimed, having a wart, festering, or having a running sore: you shall not offer these to Yahweh, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to Yahweh.
22.asv: Blind, or broken, or maimed, or having a wen, or scurvy, or scabbed, ye shall not offer these unto Jehovah, nor make an offering by fire of them upon the altar unto Jehovah.

23.web: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a freewill offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.
23.asv: Either a bullock or a lamb that hath anything superfluous or lacking in his parts, that mayest thou offer for a freewill-offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

24.web: That which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut, you shall not offer to Yahweh; neither shall you do thus in your land.
24.asv: That which hath its stones bruised, or crushed, or broken, or cut, ye shall not offer unto Jehovah; neither shall ye do thus in your land.

25.web: Neither shall you offer the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner of any of these; because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”
25.asv: Neither from the hand of a foreigner shall ye offer the bread of your God of any of these; because their corruption is in them, there is a blemish in them: they shall not be accepted for you.

26.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

27.web: “When a bull, or a sheep, or a goat, is born, then it shall remain seven days with its mother; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
27.asv: When a bullock, or a sheep, or a goat, is brought forth, then it shall be seven days under the dam; and from the eighth day and thenceforth it shall be accepted for the oblation of an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

28.web: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.
28.asv: And whether it be cow or ewe, ye shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

29.web: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to Yahweh, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.
29.asv: And when ye sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving unto Jehovah, ye shall sacrifice it that ye may be accepted.

30.web: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.
30.asv: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.

31.web: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am Yahweh.
31.asv: Therefore shall ye keep my commandments, and do them: I am Jehovah.

32.web: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am Yahweh who makes you holy,
32.asv: And ye shall not profane my holy name; but I will be hallowed among the children of Israel: I am Jehovah who halloweth you,

33.web: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am Yahweh.”
33.asv: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am Jehovah.
